payload.core_mechanism_summary: Greedy reduction: each operation reduces the currently largest absolute difference |a_i - b_i| by 1, thereby minimizing sum of squared differences.
payload.rationale: The code iteratively selects the index with maximum squared difference and updates it by shrinking the absolute difference. This is a classic greedy strategy requiring dynamic max retrieval, akin to a priority queue. Despite linear max-finding, its high-level design fits greedy priority queue.
